tables.name: users
tables.description: One row per user. MVP only ever has a single row (username 'user'), created on first startup. The Part 4 login check is still hardcoded against literal 'user'/'password' and does not read this table yet; password_hash exists so real multi-user auth can be wired in later without a schema change.

tables.name: boards
tables.description: One board per user for the MVP, enforced by the UNIQUE constraint on user_id.

tables.name: columns
tables.description: Columns belonging to a board. 'position' is the 0-based display order (columns are fixed in number per the MVP but can be renamed).

tables.name: cards
tables.description: Cards belonging to a column. 'position' is the 0-based order within that column; moving a card between columns updates both column_id and position.
